findings.title: `AssignmentSource.queued` is evaluated once at class definition time instead of per instance
findings.body: `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` in the `@dataclass` definition evaluates `timezone.now()` once when the module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` instance created without an explicit `queued` argument receives the exact same timestamp (the worker's import time). Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` from `dataclasses` so that `queued` captures the time each `AssignmentSource` instance is created.

findings.title: `assignment_source` was added to `sync_status_outbound` instead of `sync_assignee_outbound`
findings.body: `IssueSyncIntegration.sync_status_outbound` (line 416) was updated to accept `assignment_source: AssignmentSource | None = None`, even though status syncing never passes `assignment_source`. Meanwhile, `src/sentry/integrations/tasks/sync_assignee_outbound.py` (line 60) passes `assignment_source=parsed_assignment_source` to `installation.sync_assignee_outbound(...)`, whose abstract signature on line 397 was not updated to include `assignment_source` (and concrete `sync_assignee_outbound` implementations that don't accept `**kwargs` will raise `TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'assignment_source'`).
